cues.en: OK, so if you open up my RBMAlgorithm.py file inside the Challenges folder of the course materials, you will see how I went about implementing a stoplist.
cues.zh: 開啟課程教材 Challenges 資料夾中的 RBMAlgorithm.py，就能看到我是如何實作排除清單的。

cues.en: In the init function, I've loaded up the MovieLens module because we need it for looking up movie titles from movie ID's.
cues.zh: 在 init 函式中，我載入 MovieLens 模組，因為需要用它根據電影 ID 查詢片名。

cues.en: We've also defined a very small stoplist here, containing just the terms sex, drugs, and rock n roll.
cues.zh: 這裡也定義了一份很小的排除清單，只包含 sex、drugs 和 rock n roll。

cues.en: This obviously isn't a real stoplist.
cues.zh: 顯然這不是真正實用的排除清單。

cues.en: You should put a lot more thought into yours, and make sure it includes the roots of words and not specific tenses or variations of them.
cues.zh: 你應該仔細規劃自己的清單，並確保列入的是字根，而非特定時態或變形。

cues.en: For example, in a real stoplist, I'd stoplist drug and not drugs to catch as many drug-related words as possible.
cues.zh: 例如，真正的排除清單中，我會用 drug 而不是 drugs，以便涵蓋盡可能多與藥物相關的詞彙。

cues.en: Next we have the buildStoplist function on line 26.
cues.zh: 接著是第 26 行的 buildStoplist 函式。

cues.en: All we're doing here is building up a dictionary that lets us quickly look up if a given item ID is banned or not.
cues.zh: 這裡只是在建立字典，讓我們能快速查詢某個項目 ID 是否被禁止。

cues.en: We iterate through every item in our training set, convert it to a raw item ID, and look up its title.
cues.zh: 逐一走訪訓練集的每個項目，轉成原始項目 ID，再查詢片名。

cues.en: If it has a title, we first convert that title to lowercase.
cues.zh: 如果有片名，先將它轉成小寫。

cues.en: Since the terms in our stoplist are also lowercase, this makes our comparison case-insensitive, which is very important.
cues.zh: 由於排除清單中的詞彙也是小寫，這樣比較時就不區分大小寫，這非常重要。

cues.en: If we find that term in our stoplist, we set a true on that item ID's entry in the stoplistLookup dictionary.
cues.zh: 如果在標題中找到排除清單的詞彙，就把 stoplistLookup 字典中該項目 ID 的項目設為 True。

cues.en: Now, if we skip down to line 53, we can see where the stoplist is applied.
cues.zh: 跳到第 53 行，就能看到排除清單套用的位置。

cues.en: As we're building up our training matrix, we check every internal item ID to see if it has been flagged in our stoplist lookup.
cues.zh: 建構訓練矩陣時，檢查每個內部項目 ID，看看它是否已在排除清單查詢表中標記。

cues.en: Only if it's not do we proceed to add it into our training data.
cues.zh: 只有未標記時，才將它加入訓練資料。

cues.en: In this way, our recommender system gets zero data about potentially offensive items, which prevents it from creating any pairings with them.
cues.zh: 如此一來，推薦系統完全沒有可能冒犯人的項目資料，就無法與它們建立任何配對。

cues.en: We can kick this off if you'd like by opening up the RBMBakeoff.py file and running it.
cues.zh: 如果想執行，可以開啟 RBMBakeoff.py 檔案並執行。

cues.en: Our code that builds up the stoplist lookup prints out any titles it encounters that get flagged, and you can see that even our little joke of a stoplist picked up some titles.
cues.zh: 建構排除清單查詢表的程式碼，會列印所有遇到並標記的片名。可以看到，即使這份玩笑般的小清單，也找出了一些作品。

cues.en: And some of them look, well, shall we say interesting.
cues.zh: 有些作品看起來，嗯，可以說很有意思。

cues.en: I'm sure you can think of quite a few items you wouldn't to see recommended alongside the movie Sex Tape for example.
cues.zh: 例如，你一定想得出好幾種不希望和 Sex Tape 這部電影一起被推薦的項目。

cues.en: So it seems like our stoplist is doing its job.
cues.zh: 所以排除清單似乎發揮作用了。

cues.en: Again, in the real world, you'd want to put a lot more thought into the actual terms you are stoplisting, and you'd want to make sure you can update and apply your stoplist very quickly, should the need arise.
cues.zh: 再提醒一次，實務上要更仔細考慮真正列入排除清單的詞彙，也要確保必要時能非常快速地更新與套用清單。
